description: This file defines the 'Activity' model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically handling operations related to customer activities such as adding and deleting activity records in the database.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Model class for handling customer activity records in the database, including adding and deleting activities.

methods.name: addActivity
methods.description: Creates a new customer activity record in the database, recording details such as customer ID, activity key, data, IP address, and timestamp.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes all activity records associated with a specific customer ID from the database.
